title: Northern Colorado men's golf finishes third at Big Sky Championship - Centennial State News
text:
Northern Colorado men’s golf team finished in third place at the Big Sky Conference Championship after their best round of the tournament on April 29. The Bears posted a final-round score of 278, nine under par, to secure their spot in the top three at Wigwam Resort.
The team’s overall performance saw them complete the championship with a total score of 857, seven under par. Their scores improved each day, with rounds of 293, 286, and finally a strong finish at 278 against other conference teams.
Kaelen Dulany led Northern Colorado with an individual final-round score of 66, six under par. Dulany’s consistent play over the last two days helped him finish third overall in the individual standings at seven under par. Thomas Barnes Grimes also contributed significantly by tying for sixth place at four under after carding a four-under-par 68 in his final round.
Other notable performances included Cooper Tate and Matias Koropeski, who both tied for sixteenth place at two over par. Tate shot a one-over-par 73 while Koropeski recorded an even-par round of 72 on the last day. Tommie Clark rounded out Northern Colorado’s lineup by finishing tied for twenty-third at seven over par following his final-round score of one-over-par 73.
The team leaderboard showed Sacramento State winning with twenty-three under par and Idaho taking second place with fourteen under par. Francis Marion and Weber State followed behind Northern Colorado in fourth and fifth places respectively.
Looking ahead, supporters are encouraged to help strengthen UNC Men’s Golf through contributions to the Up & Down Club program aimed at enhancing resources for student-athletes.
